text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon has won first! That's
right,
Mihono Bourbon has taken first
place!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I was totally off! What an incredible
runner she is!

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she really can take the Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited to see what the future holds
for
Mihono Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Classic Triple Crown... This
is the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your orders have been successfully
executed!
choice_data_list: いい走りだった、ブルボン！
いい走りだったよ、ブルボン！

text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon is enveloped in a sea of

applause, and the excitement continues
for some
time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I surmise that our next step is the
Japanese
Derby. This poses no issues, I
assume.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. I will surely win.
choice_data_list: もちろん！頑張って勝とう！

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Japanese Derby is
necessary to
take the Classic Triple
Crown. But in order to do
so, there's
something I require.

She rarely makes requests of any kind,
so I'm
eager to help her out.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My research indicates that the Japanese
Derby is
a race won by Umamusume with
good luck.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I wish to obtain a good luck
charm and
undergo training to boost my
luck.

Mihono Bourbon makes this request
completely
deadpan, and I'm left at a
loss as to how I should
respond.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't... do it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what did I even expect? All I
could ever
do was watch on the sidelines
and marvel at her...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I have to change!

At night, after coming home from the
Nakayama
Racecourse, we head to the
track because
Bourbon wants to run for
a bit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant! Wheeze... Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice is currently training. In addition, I
have
identified that she is crying. But I
can't compre—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
Thud!

Rice Shower tumbles over and Mihono
Bourbon
rushes to help, but I stop her
instinctively.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But, Trainer...

After a moment, Rice Shower stands
back up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniff...
And then she begins running again.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm going... to get stronger...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll get stronger... and someday... I'll
catch up to
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have difficulty deciphering
emotions.
What was that just now?

Thinking back, I remember Rice Shower
saying
something similar before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I can even come close to performing
like that in
the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I'll finally be able to say
goodbye to
the Rice Shower that only
brings misfortune and
sadness to
everyone...

Rice Shower doesn't see Mihono
Bourbon as a
competitor—she sees her
as an inspiration and an
ideal to strive
toward.

And while she carries that aspiration, it's

apparent that she's not satisfied with
herself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Frustration"...

Mihono Bourbon repeats the word
quietly, but
the meaning doesn't seem
to click with her.

I'm concerned about Rice Shower... but I
can't sit
here worrying forever.

The long-awaited Japanese Derby is
coming up
soon, and we have to get in
the right mindset for
it.
